entries.question: Confirm the whole-app intent: a local-first Studio for human and agent authors, following early CodeCharge Studio page/form/control workflows and compact contextual UI; visual SQLite schema and query builders; public and authenticated generated pages; a model-derived application flow map; modular independently runnable TypeScript/Next.js applications; safe migrations and regeneration preserving data and authored extensions; shared UI/MCP commands from the first slice. Completion requires building and exercising two unrelated applications without hidden schema edits. Initial scope is one SQLite and TypeScript target; hosted collaboration, other database/language targets and exact replication of old bugs are excluded. Packaging and library choices are planning decisions. Is this the intended scope?
entries.rationale: User explicitly confirmed the complete intent summary in the asynchronous question reply.
